title: KeyManifestProduction
description: The keys the Root currently delegates, and the scope of each. Authorised by the ACTIVE Root Authority Set: at least `threshold` DISTINCT authorities of that set must sign it. It answers WHAT the Root delegates; who may exercise Root authority is the Root Authority Set, a separate artifact.
_boundary: Production of the BANZA protocol, not financial production. BANZA is an open protocol; it does not process payments, settle value, or move funds. Licence/authorisation belongs to the operator, not to BANZA.

manifest_version.description: Version of this key manifest document.

protocol_version.description: BANZA protocol version the manifest applies to (e.g. '1.0.0').

keys.description: Published public keys. Private keys never appear.

public_key.description: Public key material only (base64url). Private keys are NEVER included.

hash.description: Content hash of the manifest for tamper-evidence.

value.description: Hex or base64url digest over the canonical manifest bytes (excluding this field).

root_authority_set.description: The Root Authority Set that authorised this manifest. Binds the manifest to one specific set rather than to whichever set a verifier happens to hold.

set_sequence.description: Sequence of the authorising set. A verifier MUST reject a manifest whose set is not the active one.

digest.description: SHA-256 over that set's signing input. Identity, not just position.

root_signatures.description: Signatures by authorities of the active Root Authority Set over this document's signing input — the BCJ/1 canonical bytes excluding `root_signatures` itself. At least `threshold` DISTINCT authority_ids must verify; two signatures from one authority are one approval, so a single custodian cannot authorise a delegation alone.

authority_id.description: An authority of the active set. An id outside that set contributes nothing to the threshold.
